draft_placeholders.executive_summary: DRAFT FOR INTERNAL REVIEW: PSEG Long Island seeks temporary generation projects on behalf of LIPA. The captured RFP specifies at least 5 MW per project, a three-year base term starting between May 1, 2028 and May 1, 2030, and an optional extended term through October 31, 2039. A direct rental response has not been qualified. Determine whether a developer-led partnership can provide the PPA, site control, interconnection, operating and financial obligations before preparing a proposal. No 2G capacity, pricing, availability or compliance is asserted. Source: RFP sections 1.3.8, 1.4.1, 2.1 and 2.2.
draft_placeholders.technical_response: TBD by engineering: proposed site and minimum 5 MW configuration; 13 kV distribution or 23 kV+ transmission route; dispatchability, interconnection protection, emissions/permits, fuel interconnection, commissioning tests and operations plan. Review public RFP Appendix C and the retained interconnection requirements. No equipment model or verified site design selected.
draft_placeholders.commercial_response: TBD by authorized commercial/legal review: PPA counterparty/developer partnership, pricing, three-year base term and extension options, site control, security equal to 30% of Notional Value per section 5.3.13.4, insurance under Appendix E, required procurement forms and NYS/ISNETworld requirements. The 30% obligation is seller security, not a stated bid bond. Check private portal amendments and obtain missing form originals with authorized access.
